notes: Read all 281 numbered source lines before editing. Native port follows the established dashboard idiom (BatteryHealthAnalyticsWidget / ChargingOptimizerWidget): the native AreaChartWrapper + useThemeChartPalette charts ports are reused, and every not-yet-ported web dependency (Recharts + chart helpers, WidgetShell, WidgetChartSummary, DataFreshness, useUnits/unitConversion, useDateFormat, numberFormat, react-i18next, lucide-react) is reproduced inline native-safe and documented here.

L1 `import { useMemo }` -> native `import {useMemo}` (plus useEffect/useState for the inline freshness tick). L2 react-i18next useTranslation('dashboard') -> module-level English-default `t(key, fallback, vars?)` with {{var}} interpolation, keeping every widget.driveEfficiencyChart.* / freshness.* key verbatim.

L3 lucide-react TrendingUp -> no native icon font: the wide-header icon becomes a small cyan (colors.accent) '\u2197' TrendGlyph; the WidgetChartSummary emptyIcon TrendingUp (L277) is dropped (native EmptyState has no icon slot), trend signal preserved by the header glyph.

L4-10 Recharts (AreaChart/Area/XAxis/YAxis/ResponsiveContainer/Tooltip/ReferenceLine) + chart helpers (chartGrid, axisTick, axisTickSm, chartAnimation, fmt, AREA_DEFAULTS, areaGradient) are DOM/SVG-only -> replaced by the native AreaChartWrapper (../../../components/charts/AreaChartWrapper), which renders the area series, axes, and a built-in legend. `fmt` (web charts: fmtNumber at precision, default 1) is inlined verbatim and threaded to the wrapper yFormatter exactly as the web YAxis tickFormatter used `fmt(v,0)` (L203). axisTick/axisTickSm tick styling + the unused L160 `tick`/L159 `isWide` are dropped (axis styling is internal to the native wrapper).
L11 ChartTooltip -> dropped: native AreaChartWrapper has no hover tooltip (touch surface); the per-point values surface via its built-in legend latest-value row instead.

L12 useVehicles imported unchanged from ../../../api/hooks/useVehicles (same /vehicles path; vehicles?.[0]?.id fallback preserved). L13 @/hooks/useUnits -> inline `useUnits()` deriving unitPrefs.distance from the native useSettings exactly as web deriveDistance (unit_of_length === 'mi' -> 'mi' else 'km'); only distance is read by this widget so the mirror exposes just that pref (useMemo for reference stability).

L14 @/api/client request -> native ../../../api/client request (same resilient fetch, auto /api/v1 prefix). L15 @/lib/numberFormat fmtNumber -> inlined verbatim (safeNumber guard, en-US grouping, default precision 2). L16 @/lib/unitConversion convertDistanceFromSI -> inlined verbatim (km=m/1000, mi=m/1609.344, ft=m/0.3048; NIST constants). L17 @/hooks/useDateFormat formatDateShort -> inline `formatDateShort` mirroring web lib/dateFormat.formatDateShort (month short + day numeric, '\u2014' on invalid; device locale, the unconfigured default).

L18 './WidgetShell' -> inline `WidgetShell`: loading -> skeleton (testID drive-efficiency-chart-loading); error -> centred errorBox + retry Pressable mirroring web <QueryError> (testID drive-efficiency-chart-error); titled -> header (TrendGlyph + uppercase muted title + WidgetFreshness) over body; title-less (compact) -> body with WidgetFreshness overlaid top-right (web absolute top-1.5 right-1.5). Honours exactly the props this widget passes (title, icon, loading, error, updatedAt, isFetching, isStale, isError, onRefresh, noPadding); noPadding toggles body padding as the web shell does (L165, L269).

L19 './shared' WidgetChartSummary + ChartSummaryStat -> inline `WidgetChartSummary` + local `ChartSummaryStat`: same isEmpty -> EmptyState fallback (testID drive-efficiency-chart-empty), the same stat row (label + value + optional unit), and the chart rendered below only when !compact (testID drive-efficiency-chart-plot), matching the web `{!compact && <chart/>}` (L61). L20 './types' WidgetProps -> local `WidgetProps`/`WidgetSize` (vehicleId + size.cols/size.rows read).

L21 `import type { Drive }` from @/api/types -> `import type {ApiDrive as Drive}` from the native useDriving hook (zero runtime: type-only import erases at compile time). ApiDrive matches the web Drive snake_case SI shape exactly (distance_m, energy_used_wh, start_soc_pct, end_soc_pct, start_ts read here).

Companion __tests__/DriveEfficiencyChartWidgetParity.test.tsx mocks @tanstack/react-query useQuery, the api/client request, useVehicles and useSettings, and renders: loading skeleton; wide-with-data (Avg 175 / Best day 150 / Trend -25% / Wh/km, chart plot + area + Daily/7-day avg legend + freshness); standard 2x2 (stats + chart); Wh/mi units; positive +33.3% trend; compact (title-less, stats only, no chart plot); empty state; query-error box; the drives query shape (queryKey ['drives', id, 'efficiency-chart-60'], enabled, staleTime 120000, queryFn -> request('/drives?vehicle_id=ID&limit=60')); vehicleId fallback to first vehicle id; explicit vehicleId; and enabled=false when no vehicle id. Every test unmounts so the 30s freshness interval leaves no open handle.

Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck (tsc --noEmit), npm run lint -- --quiet (eslint .), npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles (jest). No DOM, react-router, framer-motion, lucide-react, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported into the native output.
